name: Popover
summary: Floating panel anchored to a trigger. Hosts richer content than Tooltip — a form, a mini-detail card, a filter group, a date pad. Three open behaviors — click (default), hover-with-intent (rare; mostly preview cards), and manual (controlled). Portaled per AGENTS.md hard rule 10. Distinct from Dialog (modal interrupt) and Tooltip (text-only hover hint).

modal.description: When true, focus is trapped inside the popover and the rest of the page becomes inert. Use for filter / date / quick-form popovers where the user is explicitly editing. Outside-click still closes.

arrow.description: Render a chevron pointing at the trigger. Off by default — most Lumen popovers are flush, not pointed.

width.description: trigger: match trigger width (date / select-style). auto: shrink-to-fit. sm/md/lg: 240/320/420 px.

keyboard: Tab - cycle focusables inside (when modal=true, trapped; when modal=false, leaves the popover and continues page focus)
rules: role='dialog' (the W3C ARIA APG pattern). aria-label or aria-labelledby is required when there is interactive content inside.
Per AGENTS.md hard rule 10 — portal to document.body, position via getBoundingClientRect re-tracked on scroll (capture phase) + resize.
Outside-click dismiss must exempt the portaled panel.
Returns focus to the trigger on close.
When modal=true: focus trap; rest of page becomes inert (Radix Popover handles this).
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: skip the zoom-in entry; keep the fade and translation.

do: Use for mini-detail cards (hover a chart point — see breakdown), filter pads, date pads, quick forms.
When the popover hosts an input or button, set aria-label (e.g. 'Filter pickup window').
Keep width responsive — width='trigger' for form-anchored popovers, 'auto' or 'sm'/'md' for menus.
Pair with hover trigger ONLY for preview / quickread surfaces. Click is the operator default.
Match radius to surface — radius.popover for free-floating, radius.control.md when anchored under an input.
dont: Don't render the panel as <div absolute>. Portal it (hard rule 10).
Don't make a Popover modal=true by default — that's a Dialog.
Don't open on hover with no exit affordance — the user must be able to dismiss with Escape and click-outside.
Don't put long-form prose inside. Use Drawer or route to a page.
Don't paint the panel surface in lime — chrome, not action.

changelog.note: Initial Popover contract. Click / hover / manual triggers. Portaled. Optional modal=true focus trap. Width modes: trigger / auto / sm / md / lg.
